notes.subject: ⟨के⟩
notes.rationale: Magahi needs the linker के before the purpose clause; Hebrew's ל prefix carries it alone.

notes.subject: ओकर काम
notes.rationale: מעשהו — 'his work': God's work (KJV, BSB) vs man's work (Wycliffe); also 'all men whom he hath made' (ASV/JPS reading אנשי מעשהו as 'men of his making').

notes.subject: हाथ पर मुहर लगाथिन
notes.rationale: חתם 'to seal' the hand — idiom for stopping human activity (work ceases in winter storms); literal seal kept.

translation: ऊ हर आदमी के हाथ पर मुहर लगाथिन, ⟨के⟩ सब आदमी ओकर काम के जानथिन।
